user.title: Home Camera
user.description: Adds the Cameras panel to the sidebar, for every user (administrators choose the cameras in its Settings tab), and the home camera cards to your dashboards. The panel starts with every camera found in Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Camera is already set up.

legacy_dashboard_install.title: Old Home Camera Card dashboard entry still installed
legacy_dashboard_install.description:
The card is still installed as a **Dashboard** entry from before 4.0 (folder `{folder}`). The Marketplace now downloads `home_camera.zip` for it, so its updates fail with "The installed content has no home_camera.zip".

In **Settings → Marketplace**, open the Home Camera entry of type **Dashboard** and remove it. Keep the **Integration** entry: it already serves the cards, and your dashboards keep working. Then restart Home Assistant.
